```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(knitr)
tbl <- function(d, cap) {
  if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return(invisible(NULL))
  print(kable(d, caption = cap, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

This report was generated by the **RAISINS Growth Rate Estimation** module. Significance is assessed at &alpha; = `r params$alpha`.

```{r growth, results='asis'}
tbl(params$growth, "Table 1. Growth rates (CGR, CAGR and average annual growth)")
```

```{r trend, results='asis'}

```

}

## Interpretation

```{r interp, results='asis'}
txt <- params$interp
if (!is.null(txt)) {
  # turn the HTML bullet list into plain markdown bullets for all formats
  items <- regmatches(txt, gregexpr("<li>(.*?)</li>", txt))[[1]]
  items <- gsub("<.*?>", "", items)
  if (length(items)) cat(paste0("- ", items, collapse = "\n")) else cat(gsub("<.*?>", "", txt))
}
```
